definitions.explanation: a building or structure that has been partially destroyed by fire

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{半焼|はんしょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The neighboring house was partially burned.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火事|かじ}→火事：01283_kaji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{半焼|はんしょう}し、⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{運|はこ}ばれた→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: A house was partially burned in the fire and two people were taken to the hospital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{消防|しょうぼう}{署|しょ}→消防署：06454_shoubousho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦{全焼|ぜんしょう}→全焼：17094_zenshou⟧{三棟|さんとう}、{半焼|はんしょう}{五棟|ごとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: According to the fire department's announcement, three buildings were fully destroyed and five were partially burned.

notes:
A term used in fire reports and news to describe buildings that have been partially destroyed by fire. In Japanese fire damage classification, structures are categorized as ⟦{全焼|ぜんしょう}→全焼：17094_zenshou⟧ (fully burned), {半焼|はんしょう} (partially burned), or {部分焼|ぶぶんしょう} (minor fire damage).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{半焼|はんしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: a house is partially burned
- {半焼|はんしょう}⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧: partial fire damage
- {半焼|はんしょう}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: partially burned condition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{全焼|ぜんしょう}→全焼：17094_zenshou⟧: total fire destruction — the building is completely destroyed by fire
- {部分焼|ぶぶんしょう}: minor fire damage — less severe than {半焼|はんしょう}
- ⟦{焼失|しょうしつ}→焼失：13480_shoushitsu⟧: destruction by fire — general term for loss due to fire
- ⟦{類焼|るいしょう}→類焼：18581_ruishou⟧: fire spreading from another building — damage from a fire that started elsewhere
